---
title: "Masonry layout"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
extensions:
  photo-gallery:
    layout: masonry
    columns: 5
    gap: 6
    date-format: "MMMM D, YYYY"
    datetime-format: "MMMM D, YYYY [at] h:mm A"
---

The masonry layout uses CSS columns to produce a Pinterest-style staggered layout. Images flow into columns without cropping, so taller and wider photos keep their proportions.

## 5 columns

You can pass the album folder as a positional argument; all the other settings come from the frontmatter defaults above:

```{.markdown shortcodes=false}
{{< photo-gallery img/ >}}
```

{{< photo-gallery img/ >}}

## 4 columns via shortcode argument

Override `columns` for a single gallery call without changing the page defaults:

```{.markdown shortcodes=false}
{{< photo-gallery img/ columns=4 gap=20 id="five-col" >}}
```

{{< photo-gallery img/ columns=4 gap=20 id="five-col" >}}
